# World events

---

Every **4-7 minutes** one event happens near a random player in the Overworld (the first one about 3 minutes after the world loads). Toggle them at a **War Table**; creative players can start any event there, and anyone with commands can run `/scriptevent bc:event <name>`.

## The event director (v0.7.0)

* **Scaling:** each player has an event **tier** from their magic level plus 3 per companion nearby: tier 1 (under 7), tier 2 (7-15), tier 3 (16+). Enemy counts in raids, rituals, hives, assassins and pirate landings are ×1 / ×1.4 / ×1.8, and the nastiest outcomes (a Bandit King leading a raid, the Grimoire Devourer or the Hive Queen when you fail) need tier 2.
* **No repeats:** the last two events are never picked again.
* **Pacing:** 25+ kills since the last event push the next one 50% later; 2 or fewer bring it 30% sooner.
* **Objectives:** raids, rituals, hives and assassins are won by defeating every enemy (or egg) in time - with a reward - and some have consequences when you fail. Their enemies never break and run.
* **Event log:** the last 12 events and how they ended are in the Handbook (**Recent events**).

| Event (`name`) | Weight | When | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mana meteor shower (`meteor_shower`) | 10 | any time | For 30 s mana meteors fall within 7-30 blocks; each impact may leave a Mana Crystal (50%). |
| Devil Gate (`devil_gate`) | 8 × Devil power | any time | A 120-HP Devil Gate opens 18-26 blocks away and releases imps and Dark Disciples every 8 s (up to 12 devils) for ~96 s. Break it for 120 XP and a star. If it survives, 30% chance the Archdevil steps out. |
| Pirate landing (`pirate_landing`) | 8 × Raider power | any time | A Raider Captain and 4-6 Sea Raiders come ashore 18-24 blocks away. |
| Skirmish (`skirmish`) | 10 | any time | Two factions (stronger ones more often, 60% against their rival) fight a 4-6 a side battle with random tactics 20 blocks ahead. The result changes faction power. |
| Knights' tournament (`knight_tournament`) | 4 | day | Two level 3-7 Magic Knights of random magic duel 14 blocks ahead. |
| Knight patrol (`knight_patrol`) | 6 × Knight power | day | Three Magic Knights appear 14-20 blocks away. |
| Travelling merchant (`merchant`) | 7 | any time | The Travelling Magic Merchant sets up shop for 6 minutes (see [Items](items-and-recipes.md#travelling-magic-merchant)). |
| Sky treasure (`sky_treasure`) | 6 | any time | A golden beam marks a spot 24-36 blocks away; after 5 s a chest lands (doubloons, mana crystals, ancient pages, diamonds, sometimes a fruit, contract, horn or map) and three Sea Raiders go for it. |
| Crimson night (`crimson_night`) | 4 × Devil power | night | For 2 minutes a red moon hangs over every player and devils spawn near them every 10 s; each one slain gives +25 magic XP. |
| Wounded knight (`wounded_knight`) | 5 | any time | A badly hurt Magic Knight is surrounded by Dark Disciples or a Hellhound 14-20 blocks away. Kill the attackers while the knight lives and it joins your party with 150 bond. |
| Mana storm (`mana_storm`) | 5 | any time | For 45 s everyone in the Overworld regains 4 mana per second and wild lightning strikes monsters near players (8 dmg). |
| Bounty hunters (`bounty_hunters`) | 4 | your bounty is 300+ | Two Tidewatch Marksmen and two Sentinels (plus a Commodore at 1500+) ambush you. |
| Bandit raid (`bandit_raid`) | 8 × power | any time | 3-5 Bandits, 1-2 Archers and a Thief (scaled) attack from 18-24 blocks away; at tier 2+ there is a 30% chance the Bandit King leads them. **Objective:** defeat them all within 4 minutes for 30 + 8 per raider doubloons, a star and 80 XP. |
| Devil ritual (`devil_ritual`) | 5 × Devil power | night | 3+ Cultists (scaled) and two imps chant in a circle 20-26 blocks away. **Objective:** kill the cultists within 90 s (a countdown shows) for a star, 150 XP and 4 Mana Crystals. **If they finish:** the Grimoire Devourer wakes (tier 2+) or a Devil Gate opens. |
| Hive infestation (`hive_infestation`) | 5 | any time | 5+ Hive Eggs (hatching after 60-100 s) and 3+ drones appear 18-24 blocks away. **Objective:** destroy every egg within 2 minutes for 40 doubloons, a star and 120 XP. **If you fail** at tier 2+, the Hive Queen emerges. |
| Assassins (`assassins`) | 3 | night, 5+ stars or magic level 8+ | 2-4 invisible Shadow Assassins hunt you. Defeat them for 25 doubloons, a star and 100 XP. |
| A thief (`thief`) | 4 | you carry 20+ doubloons | An invisible Bandit Thief sneaks up behind you. Catch it if it robs you! |
| Mana Eclipse (`mana_eclipse`) | 4 | any time | For 3 minutes: +25% spell power for everyone (enemies included), ×1.5 magic XP, and monsters near players gain Strength. |
| Rogue ambush (`rogue_ambush`) | 6 | any time | 3-4 Rogue Mages (one of them stronger) attack from 14-20 blocks away; 35% of the time two Magic Knights who were hunting them arrive behind you. |
| Fallen Captain (`fallen_captain`) | 2 | night | The Fallen Captain appears 20-26 blocks away. |
| Witch Sisters (`witch_sisters`) | 2 | night | Fog rolls in; after 2 s the Frost Witch and the Ember Witch arrive 20-26 blocks away. |
| Bone Dragon (`bone_dragon`) | 2 | night, above y 55 | The Bone Dragon wakes 26-32 blocks away. |
| Rival squad (`rival_squad`) | 5 | day, you lead at least one companion | A squad of 2-4 knights from another company (levels close to your companions') challenges your party to a friendly match. See [Companions](companions.md#training-and-sparring). |
| Puppet show (`puppet_show`) | 2 | night | A music box plays; after 2 s the Soul Puppeteer appears 20-26 blocks away. |
| Colossus (`colossus`) | 3 | day, above y 55 | A Stone Colossus rises 26-32 blocks away. |
| Phantom Galleon (`phantom_galleon`) | 3 | night | A ghostly fog rolls in; after 2 s the Phantom Galleon appears. |
| Kraken (`kraken`) | 3 | deep water within 20 blocks | The Storm Kraken rises from the water. |
| Offensive (automatic) | – | a faction at power 80+ | See [AI & simulation](ai-and-simulation.md#the-world-simulation-worldsimjs). |

If an event cannot find a good spot (water, cliffs, unloaded chunks) another is tried 30 seconds later.
